reason: amoCRM charges me per seat and the bill keeps growing, so a flat 25 dollars for contacts and deals only is exactly what I need. Free migration and a 14-day trial with my own clients means I lose nothing by trying it.
objection: No customer references. If it breaks or they disappear I lose my client data, and 25 dollars covers only 3 users while I have more staff, so I would really be paying 49.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing one or two real shops like mine in Uzbekistan using it, or a way to export all my data any time.
